items.title: Heatbit's $899 Water Heater Element Mines Bitcoin While It Heats Your Tank
items.summary: The Bitwater element swaps a tank's resistance wire for 20 mining chips, and Heatbit says it uses the same electricity to heat the water.

items.title: Bitcoin in 'Wait and See Mode'—And That Might Be a Good Thing
items.summary: The crypto market has been quiet as of late. Market analysts think that might actually be a good sign and that a bull market might be near.

items.title: Is the Internet Safe Again After the PHP Nightmare? What You Need to Know
items.summary: PHP shipped its fix, attackers launched millions of attempts, and governments say no one has broken in yet. Here's what that means for your passwords, your crypto, and your browsing.

items.title: a16z Drops Crypto From Its Name, Widens Bets to AI and Frontier Tech
items.summary: Andreessen Horowitz is renaming its crypto fund a16z Frontier and widening its scope to AI, autonomous machines and biology, saying the line between crypto and everyday tech has blurred.

items.title: Coinbase Fined Again in Ireland, This Time $3.6M Over Fund Safeguarding
items.summary: The Central Bank of Ireland penalized Coinbase Ireland €3,252,618 for leaning too heavily on its U.S. parent and leaving its safeguarding account underfunded—its second hit to the exchange’s European arm in the last year.

items.title: Bitcoin ETFs Erase October Losses With $1 Billion in Three Days
items.summary: Spot Bitcoin ETFs have drawn about $1.07 billion over three sessions, pushing October flows to a gain of roughly $460 million, even as Bitcoin and Ethereum prices slipped.

items.title: What Is a Neocloud? The GPU Clouds Powering the AI Boom
items.summary: Neoclouds like CoreWeave and Nebius rent Nvidia GPUs to AI labs, and several started out mining crypto. Here's how the AI cloud model works.

items.title: SoFi Launches Tokenized Deposit That Earns 4.4% and Converts to a Stablecoin
items.summary: Each SOFIE token represents $1 on deposit at SoFi Bank, earning 4.40% APY with FDIC insurance—a yield-and-protection combination ordinary stablecoins lack.

items.title: Italy Busts Mafia 'Secret Bank' That Laundered Money Through Crypto, Seizes $24M
items.summary: Police say a car-rental firm near Milan was an underground bank for 'Ndrangheta and Camorra figures, moving money abroad and into crypto.

items.title: Chinese Prosecutors Seek to Confiscate $5.1B in Bitcoin Seized by UK in Qian Case
items.summary: A Tianjin court will hear the application after a six-month notice period, while a parallel fight over the same coins continues in London.

items.title: Bitcoin Hits Weekly High as Crypto Market Rebounds
items.summary: Bitcoin is back near $84,500 as XRP and Zcash lead a broad crypto rebound from October's slide, putting "Uptober" back on the table.

items.title: Dogecoin Gets a Dedicated Company to Build Out Its Ecosystem
items.summary: Formed with the Dogecoin Foundation and led by MyDoge founder Jordan Jefferson, the new company consolidates the MyDoge wallet, DogeOS app platform, and Such App to build an economy around DOGE.

items.title: Musk’s SpaceX-Tesla Merger Would Create a Bitcoin Treasury Behemoth
items.summary: Musk said both boards formed committees to weigh a tie-up that would combine Tesla’s 11,509 BTC and SpaceX’s 18,712 BTC—roughly $2.5 billion worth—onto a single balance sheet.

items.title: What Is a Bitcoin-Backed Loan? Borrowing Against BTC Explained
items.summary: Bitcoin-backed loans let holders borrow cash or stablecoins without selling BTC. Here's how collateral, LTV and liquidations work.

items.summary: The new consensus protocol retires TowerBFT, which had run Solana since its 2020 launch, after a handoff on the live network.

items.title: GTA 6 Trailer Features 'Dacity' Meme Coin—Here's What Traders Think It'll Do
items.summary: Grand Theft Auto 6 is rumoured to feature a meme coin, and crypto traders are speculating on how prominently Rockstar will integrate it.

items.title: Morning Minute: Bitcoin Tops JPMorgan’s Ten-Year Forecast for All Assets
items.summary: The bank has Bitcoin outperforming all asset classes spanning real estate, stocks and gold over the next 10-15 years.

items.title: OCC Finalizes GENIUS Act Stablecoin Rules Ahead of January Deadline
items.summary: The rule sets reserve, redemption and risk standards for issuers, but the OCC has yet to say when it will begin accepting applications.

items.summary: Sixteen companies have now objected to having their shares traded on the planned OKX-ICE tokenized stock venue, up from nine just four days earlier, according to an updated public notice.

items.title: Swiss Regulator Approves First Retail Fund That Holds Bitcoin Directly
